name: mv
summary: Move or rename files and directories.
description: Rename SOURCE to DEST, or move SOURCE(s) to DIRECTORY.

examples.title: Rename a file
examples.explanation: Changes filename from old.txt to new.txt.

examples.title: Move files to directory
examples.explanation: Moves report.pdf into the Documents folder.

warnings: mv overwrites an existing destination without asking; check the target path before moving, especially between directories.
